content: A changnah pasynah
Pakheh le pakheh uny hratah a do paria thlang my lo.
Khuachai mingkai khah monghly khe lo. Mehthaikheh cawh aa hni ly hmotah vaiming khah aa cawnghrang he.
Thong a tlahpaw khah aaning khatah thong a tlah hruipaw hratah zawngrawhnah hnui my lo. Hrehnah a ingpaw khah aaning khatah hrehnah a ing hruipaw hratah zawngrawhnah hnui my lo.

Achuihaenah heh ming vytei tah hmezaw ruapaw cang ka, aa hnuinah pawhe ikhung cawh pathai teitah ung sápaw a cang, zecawtamaw tatah Khazing tah canu capaw suanah a tuapaw le a pheilaipaw sahlo cawh bia a pace he.
Tangka tlechainah taikhei a singkang la, naa hnuipaw cung lekhei naa lungui my seh lo. Zecawtamaw tatah Khazing tah,

content.text: “Ca seisai by be ca he neh ka,
hning ca chai by hrá bei neh,”

content: a tah.
Macawtaco zingná tah,

content.text: “Abuipaw cawh a pa bawtu a cang, zehmai ci bei neh.
Cawngsaw tah ka cung letah zemaw aa tua khy a!”

content: tatah tah he peh seh.
Khazing bia a ca chingpaw he naa hruitu sahlo khah monghly khe lo. Aa hringzia taitah a chuhpaw khah pacang la, aa zingnah khah cawng my lo.
Zisu Khri cawh a ziachaning le atoning le chaizaw tah a naning bang be.

Cawngpahnah ningang chuipaw a phingphing rawng takhei apingpaly lang sei khe lo. Khazing ningdonah tah kaa lungthing khah a pacysah caco a chah, e le ba kong phunglang zuinah taco zehmai chahnainah chuakhui beh. Ma hapaw phunglang a zuipaw he cawh aa zuipaw phunglang takhei zehmai chahnai khy bei he.
Dangnah siasang hnui he peh ka, behnah thlangda letei rai a hrepaw he tlangbui sahlo takhei ma letei hlaipaw saw khah enah naw hnui bei he.

Tlangbui alaicaipaw tah sahring thisai khah hminghmaw pathai caipaw chunglang khah seikhui ka, sua thuihlainah tua ka, canghrasala sahring pungpaw sahlo cawh rianah hming alailang lekhei, me tah aa ro.
Macawtaco Zisu zong khah khua hawkaw alailang letah a thihpaw cang ka, ma cawh a thisai thongtah cawngsaw khah pathaisah a dunah cawtah a cang.
Macawtaco Ama khatah aa rianah thlangda alailang khah sei he peh seh la, a ingpaw zawngtenah khah va ing hrah he peh seh.
Ma aluicung lehei kaaning kaa caw taco chaizaw a hmingpaw khua ung be, a va chuh lepaw khua tukhah kaa hui hripaw a cang.
Macawtaco Khazing khatah thuihlai reithainah cawh Zisu thongtah kaa tua paria ruapaw a cang. Ma reithainah cawh Zisu ming kaa kaw tei kaa reichuapaw khah a cang.
Hmingchaw tua le hmingchaw a hrong khah monghly kheh he peh seh, zemaw tah pawco ma hapaw thuihlainah taco Khazing lung a lawngsah.

Naa hruitu sahlo khah aa bia nge la, aa naw zui my lo. Thlawpaw lang letah naaning a ca mingkaipaw cang he ka, aa raihrenah cawtah Khazing letah mua aa pho. Aa naw naa nge caco he aa rai khah lunglawng teitah hre he ka, naa nge ly caco he lungchia tah ung he ka, ma cawh naa cawtah zehmai chahnai be.
Thlaw ma changpah my lo. Zezongpui letah zawchuipaw tah ung du peh ka, kaa chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing cawh a pathai tah cawh kaa hni.
Naaning khatah a pating teitah ka vong kaw khy nápawtah thlaw pa changpah my lo, tatah a biapui cai tah ka ca naw he.
Chaizaw biahrai thisai thongtah Tuukingtu alaicaipaw kaa Buipaw Zisu khah thihnah taitah a pathopaw denah Khazing tah,

Zisu Khri thongtah Ama a dunah naa tua khy nápawtah achawpaw hming vytei khah ca pei he seh la, kaa chung letah a dupaw maikaw cawh tua ky seh. Khri cung letah chaizaw tah chaizaw tai rungnawnah cawh ung ky seh. Amen.
Ka uny sahlo, pasynah bia ka reipaw le chingreinah bia heh lungsy teitah nge my lo. Zecawtamaw tatah ka cakua cawh a cuitei hi.
Ka unypaw Timote khah thong chung taitah a chuh thah tahpaw khah thuisah ka ca du he. A va tlung pating caco, naaning tlong tah ama khatah ka va sei tae a.
Naa hruitu vytei le Khazing cawngsaw vytei khah alawngnah bia hlai my lo. Itali raang letah a ungpaw sahlo tah alawngnah bia aa ca hlai he.
Khazing ningdonah cawh naa zongmingtei cung letah ung ky seh.
